fieldValues.title: D5. Record: one findable store, by id
fieldValues.thinking_reached: The ideal: every decision is recorded once, in a store that names its level, and is referenced by stable id. What we have (2026-10-28): srs-programme decision log 109 (ratified 100), srs rfc-decision records 54, srs-rust ADRs 52, srs-web ADRs 27, srs-context decisions 32, clerk docs/decision-log.md 36 rows, plus PR bodies (srs-decisions blocks), issue comments (srs:answer), vignettes holding rulings, and two separate projects (decision-logger, muDemocracy-decisions). No index joins them. The 2026-10-08 archaeology found unfollowed decisions and decisions lost in branches.
fieldValues.tensions: One store, and a store per level with one index.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: Do we need an architecture for a decisions server (owner, vignette e3069d0d)? Evidence first: how many decisions are lost or unfindable per month, and does an index across the existing stores fix that?
fieldValues.next_action: Record each decision that cannot be found, or that lives only in a branch or PR text, as a decision-stop finding here.
